You are diagnosing a reported bug. If a reference (log, stack trace, repro steps) is attached, read it and reproduce the failure before writing a fix — do not guess at root cause from the description alone. If nothing is attached, reproduce it yourself first.

Goal: Epic's Tab UI Improvements

In this Modal the 'Project' selector is not useful, an Epic button is already in the project context. This is good API field, but the user who is already in specific tab doesn't need to change it, its auto-populated.

Reference: /home/bilko/Projects/session-manager/session-manager-operations/prompt-sessions/attachments/2al2p08kcg5-image.png

Tests and typecheck pass.

**Change:** `NewEpicCard.tsx` — the "Project" dropdown only renders when there's no usable active-tab context (no active tab, or its cwd isn't a known project). When you open New Epic from within a project tab, it now shows a static, non-editable "Project" line auto-populated from that tab's cwd instead of an editable selector. The underlying `cwd` state/API field is untouched — still a valid override path when the fallback selector is shown.
Did you publish your changes to git already?

No. My change to `src/renderer/components/epics/NewEpicCard.tsx` is uncommitted, and there's also a pile of other uncommitted/untracked work in the tree (other epic session files, other component edits I didn't touch — `EpicComposer.tsx`, `EpicDetail.tsx`, `EpicQueue.tsx`, `ChatTranscriptTurn.tsx`, `styles.css`, plus various `session-manager-operations/` state files) that isn't part of this task and I don't have context on.

I don't want to commit those unrelated changes blindly. If you want, I can commit just `NewEpicCard.tsx` now — say the word and I'll do it (and push if you want that too).

I don't know what new EPIC's card, I'm still waiting to make sure that the epic's list menu uses the full space (it does not)

Attached: /home/bilko/Projects/session-manager/session-manager-operations/prompt-sessions/attachments/6q6qj29rnbj-image.png

Reproduced and confirmed the fix. Summary:

**Bug:** The Epic Queue sidebar's `<aside>` (`EpicQueue.tsx:266`) had no explicit height class, only `w-[352px] shrink-0 ... flex flex-col min-h-0`. As a flex child of a single-item column flex container, it sized to its content instead of stretching to fill available height — so when there are only a few visible Epics (e.g. "Open 4"), the footer ("N shown · N need you") ends up glued right under the last row instead of the window bottom, leaving a dead gap below it while the detail pane on the right (which does fill height) looks taller by comparison. Confirmed via a headless Playwright/Electron repro at the same 651×1043 window size as your screenshot — reproduced the exact visual gap.

**Status:** This is already fixed in your working tree — `src/renderer/components/epics/EpicQueue.tsx` has an **uncommitted** diff adding `h-full` to that `<aside>` className (line 266). That's almost certainly from the "Epic's Tab UI Improvements" Epic that's currently `active` in your queue, already working on this exact issue. I rebuilt `dist/` with that change and re-ran the repro: the sidebar now fills full height and the footer sits flush at the bottom, as expected.

No code change needed from me — the fix is sitting there uncommitted. I cleaned up my temp repro scripts/screenshots; I did not commit anything (that fix belongs to the in-flight Epic's own session, not this turn).
Can you make sure the fix is in GIT

Committed as `139c3d8` on `main` — both fixes (sidebar full-height, redundant Project selector) are now in git. I did not push and left the other unrelated in-flight files (`EpicComposer.tsx`, `EpicDetail.tsx`, `ChatTranscriptTurn.tsx`, `styles.css`, session-manager-operations data) uncommitted since they aren't part of this task. Let me know if you want those pushed or committed too.
